HealthRecord.title: HealthRecord
HealthRecord.description: Personal health timeline entry, symptom log, lab note, or doctor visit preparation workspace item.

title.description: Short title of the health record or doctor visit topic (1-150 chars).

details.description: Detailed notes, symptom history, or report summary (1-2000 chars).

facilityOrDoctor.description: Hospital, clinic, PHCs, or doctor name (0-150 chars).

questionsForDoctor.description: Prepared questions to ask the clinician during visit (0-1000 chars).

completed.description: Whether the doctor visit or follow-up action is completed.

HealthReminder.title: HealthReminder
HealthReminder.description: Smart health reminder for medicines, vaccinations, appointments, or routine checkups.

title.description: Medicine or checkup reminder name (1-150 chars).

dosageOrNote.description: Dosage instructions, food timing, or clinic instructions (0-300 chars).

scheduleTime.description: Human-readable schedule time, e.g., 08:00 AM Daily (1-60 chars).

isActive.description: Whether the reminder notifications are enabled.

takenToday.description: Whether the dose or action was completed today.

PrivacyConsent.title: PrivacyConsent
PrivacyConsent.description: User consent, privacy, accessibility, low-bandwidth, and multilingual settings.

aiGuidanceConsent.description: Explicit user consent for non-diagnostic AI health information.

emergencyLocationConsent.description: Consent to use coarse/fine location for nearby hospital and desert detection.

anonymousPublicHealthAnalytics.description: Opt-in for anonymized regional health trend insights.

lowBandwidthMode.description: Enables compact low-data UI and offline-first caching.

highContrastMode.description: Enables enhanced contrast and large readable typography.

preferredLanguage.description: Preferred interface and AI response language (English, Hindi, Odia).

/users/{userId}/health_records/{recordId.description: Per-user health timeline entries and doctor visit preparation items.

/users/{userId}/reminders/{reminderId}.description: Per-user smart medicine, vaccination, and appointment reminders.

/users/{userId}/privacy_settings/{settin.description: Per-user trust, consent, accessibility, low-bandwidth, and language preferences.
